entities.name: EPS update result
entities.description: Information element that specifies the result of the associated updating procedure. It is a type 1 information element with coded values indicating different update outcomes.

entities.name: EPS update result IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier for the EPS update result IE, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Spare bit
entities.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero.

entities.name: EPS update result value
entities.description: Coded value in bits 3-1 of octet 1 indicating the update result: TA updated, combined TA/LA updated, TA updated and ISR activated, combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated, or reserved values.

entities.name: TA updated
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result value is 000, indicating tracking area updated.

entities.name: combined TA/LA updated
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result value is 001, indicating combined tracking area and location area updated.

entities.name: TA updated and ISR activated
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result value is 010, indicating tracking area updated and idle mode signaling reduction activated. Used only for UEs supporting A/Gb or Iu mode.

entities.name: combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result value is 011, indicating combined tracking area and location area updated and idle mode signaling reduction activated. Used only for UEs supporting A/Gb or Iu mode.

entities.name: Reserved values
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result value is any value other than 000, 001, 010, or 011.

relations.description: The EPS update result information element contains the IEI identifier field.
The EPS update result information element contains a spare bit field.
The EPS update result information element contains the update result value field.
The update result value field is guarded by the condition when value is 000 (TA updated).
The update result value field is guarded by the condition when value is 001 (combined TA/LA updated).
The update result value field is guarded by the condition when value is 010 (TA updated and ISR activated).
The update result value field is guarded by the condition when value is 011 (combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated).
The update result value field is guarded by the condition when value is any reserved value.
